name: forma
description: Turn a screenshot, a PDF, or an existing report into a real DevExpress .repx — AI-generated spec, in-browser mockup, and XtraReports XML. Bring your own Gemini key.
comment:overrides: qs: two Dependabot advisories (array-limit bypass, DoS via attacker-controlled isBuffer) are fixed in 6.16.0, but no direct dependency asks for it -- the vulnerable copy arrives via @google/genai -> @modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> express@5. `npm audit fix` cannot reach it without a breaking change, so it is pinned here instead. Every qs in the tree was already 6.x, so this is a patch-level lift, not a major. Remove this entry once the chain ships 6.16.0 on its own; `npm ls qs --all` shows whether it still bites.
comment:not-overridden: csv-parse, stream-json and uuid carry open Dependabot advisories and are deliberately NOT overridden. All three live inside firebase-tools, which is already on the latest published version (15.29.0 as of 2026-09-09), so there is no update to take -- the fix has to come from upstream. Each patched version is two majors above what is installed: csv-parse 5.6.0 -> 7.0.2, stream-json 1.9.1 -> 3.5.0, uuid 9.0.1 (via gaxios) -> 11.1.1. Forcing a major into another package's internals is a different proposition from the patch-level qs lift above, and firebase-tools runs the Firestore emulator that `npm run test:rules` depends on, so breaking it takes 70 security-rule tests with it. All three are scoped `development` by Dependabot and reach nothing that ships. Leave the alerts OPEN rather than dismissing them: an open alert closes itself when firebase-tools bumps its dependencies, a dismissed one stays silent forever. Re-check with `npm ls csv-parse stream-json uuid --all` before acting on this.
